slug: 2025-10-23 Congo relaunches NIU biometric unique-ID card production

facts.fact: The Finance Ministry relaunched production of the NIU card from September 2025, with biometric capture in physical presence, per the ministry's own article.

note: A police commander supervises the NIU project locally, but who operates or maintains the system is not stated.

facts.fact: The decree has the cards produced only by the national production centres at Brazzaville, Pointe-Noire and Oyo and issued by departmental section heads under the Interior Ministry.
